note: Preferred POI areas curated from the profile map. Small named landmarks are represented by their enclosing, black-outlined POI area. The archive splits them into a coast variant (beaches, mudflats, swamps, islands, bogs) and an ocean variant that keeps to the open sea; both land on the sea cliffs of the Coastal Bluffs.
review: Checked against the traced POI outlines: every listed area is highlighted on the profile map, and every highlighted area is listed.

variants.name: Coast Tropeognathus
variants.note: The gull of beaches, mudflats, swamps, islands and the coastal bogs: sits on rocks and sandbanks, raids kills and harasses everything that moves.

variants.name: Ocean Tropeognathus
variants.note: The ocean wanderer of Kelp Vale, the Abyssal Depths and the Stonebed Shoal: glides over the open sea, plunge-dives for fish, rests and sleeps on the water like an albatross and uses rock and the Coastal Bluffs only to dry off, sit out storms or launch.

legend.coast: Range of the coast variant (beaches, mudflats, swamps, islands and coastal bogs)
legend.ocean: Open-sea range of the ocean variant (Kelp Vale, Abyssal Depths, Stonebed Shoal)
legend.both: Sea cliffs shared by both variants (Coastal Bluffs)
